blocks.text: # Proofpress launch-day runbook

**Status:** public release live; X launch checklist active.  
**Launch owner:** Richard Tang.  
**Default public release channel:** proofpress@0.2.0 on npm `latest`, published
2026-07-26 with SLSA provenance.
## Launch decision
- **Hero channel:** X native video plus the public GitHub repository. Use the
native X upload, not a YouTube link.
- **Primary CTA:** inspect the self-verifying portable-handoff demo and star the

repository. Do not add a waitlist or Discord CTA unless there is an owner and
  a real follow-up loop.
- **Working launch window:** propose a weekday 09:00–13:00 Pacific window so the

founder can respond live through the first reaction cycle. Lock the date and
  exact minute at T-7; coverage matters more than chasing an alleged universal
  “best” posting hour.
- **Show HN:** conditional, not a launch-day dependency. The current HN guidance

requires a non-trivial thing people can run, no signup barrier, and an author
  who is present to discuss it; HN is also temporarily restricting Show HNs for
  accounts unfamiliar with the community. Submit only after the five-minute path
  passes and Richard’s account is clearly eligible. Do not recruit booster
  comments or votes. Source: <https://news.ycombinator.com/showhn.html> and
  <https://news.ycombinator.com/showlim>.
## T-7 to T-1 gates
### Product proof

- [x] Run the public proofpress@0.2.0 install in a clean Git receiver repo.
- [x] Download only examples/portable-handoff/strategy.md; inspect, import, and
verify must pass.
- [x] Confirm the README, skills, demo guide, and every launch command use
the stable 0.2.0 release channel.
- [x] Promote the stable release to npm `latest`, publish provenance, and create
the matching `v0.2.0` GitHub Release.
### Public surfaces
- [ ] Set GitHub description to: “The trust layer for multiplayer AI — an open,
agent-native ledger that travels with the artifact.”
- [ ] Replace or confirm topics: agentic-ai, multi-agent, knowledge-work,
markdown, provenance, audit-log, open-source.
- [ ] Add a deliberate social-preview image; the current repository preview is
the account avatar, not launch artwork.
- [ ] Decide the homepage / landing URL. If an owned landing domain exists, use

it as the X link with source tracking; otherwise link directly to GitHub and
  use GitHub traffic plus X analytics rather than pretending the repository URL
  has campaign attribution.
- [ ] Confirm the intended X handle and any domain availability. Registration is
an explicit owner action, not an automated launch task.
### People and coverage

- [ ] Richard posts the X thread and owns factual launch-day replies.
- [ ] Name one technical-response owner and one metrics / issue-triage owner.
- [ ] Prepare a small, real warm-contact list for private awareness only. Never
coordinate HN voting or booster comments.
- [ ] Block the first four hours after launch for replies, bug triage, and
observing the demo path.
### Reply kit

- [ ] Publish-ready answers live in [faq.md](faq.md).
- [ ] Keep the answer boundary explicit: computed claims are checkable;
rationale and attribution are stated context unless independently attested.
- [ ] Prepare one concise answer each for Git blame, C2PA, tampering, privacy,
and “why not an LLM diff?”.
## Day-of sequence

1. Re-run the five-minute portable-handoff path against the live npm tag.
2. Confirm repository description, topics, social preview, README, demo link,
X native video, and X link destination.
3. Publish the X main post with the native video; publish the founder article as
Reply 1 immediately after it.
4. Record the initial time, npm tag/version, Git commit, and link destination in
the launch log.
5. Respond with the FAQ’s honesty boundary; log recurring objections verbatim
enough to improve the product, not just the copy.
6. Reassess Show HN only after the product path and response coverage are proven.
## Go / no-go
Do not launch if any of these are false:
- a clean receiver can install proofpress@next, inspect the demo artifact,
import its ledger, and verify its claims;
